frozen_ordinary_growth: Ordinary count, stall if any member is short, nothing taken extra.
recorded_growth: Ordinary count, cancel joins of short knots, those knots wait, other knots release, nothing taken extra.
frozen_start: Every start knot holds at least three distinct places.
coverage: Each tested first roster was enumerated directly. Each archive baseline was replayed to its full horizon. Each changed run was replayed through the first round with no short member after its last edit, or through its stop. After a fully paid round, every old member spends all its usable distinctions and every new member holds at least its demand in that next roster. An implied parity birth ends the run. Thus no later unaudited round can first introduce a short member without another edit. Three selected short moves were compared through the full horizon under alternative treatments.
